ha-01: Perform the aarti of dear Hanuman — destroyer of the wicked, art of Raghunath.
ha-02: By whose strength great mountains tremble; disease and fault dare not approach.
ha-03: Anjani’s son, giver of great strength; lord of saints, always a helper.
ha-04: Raghunath sent the hero — he burned Lanka and brought news of Sita.
ha-05: Lanka’s fort and ocean-moat — the Wind-son crossed without delay.
ha-06: Burning Lanka he slew the demons; he fulfilled the work of Sita and Rama.
ha-07: When Lakshmana lay unconscious, he brought the sanjivani and saved his life.
ha-08: Entering the netherworld he broke death’s hold; he tore off Ahiravana’s arms.
ha-09: With the left arm he crushed demon hosts; with the right he saved the saints.
ha-10: Gods, humans, and sages offer aarti; they chant victory to Hanuman.
ha-11: On a golden tray the camphor flame burns — Mother Anjana performs the aarti.
ha-12: Whoever sings Hanuman’s aarti attains the supreme abode in Vaikuntha.
ha-13: Of the destruction of Lanka by Raghurai — Tulsidas sings the Lord’s glory.
ha-14: Perform the aarti of dear Hanuman — destroyer of the wicked, art of Raghunath.
